items.title: Hollander POTD Ed O'Bannon. Huge college star at UCLA won 95 title. Drafted 9th by NJ to replace Chris Morris at SF but knees were bad & jumper was iffy. Out of NBA by 98. Later, famously sued the NCAA for ripping off their players & ultimately led to the NIL world we live in.
